leadin: Answer the following about Impressionist painters.

parts.question: This French artist painted numerous water lilies scenes at his garden in Giverny. For 10 points, name this painter.
This artist painted 'A Sunday Afternoon on the Island of La Grande Jatte' using pointillism. For 10 points, name this artist.
This Dutch post-Impressionist painted 'Starry Night' and cut off part of his ear. For 10 points, name this artist.
